title: Highly recommend
text: Highly recommend. Was a great gift for my nephew who's a bachelor. He has a tiny kitchenette and this is just right for him to make dinner ahead of time for 1-4 people

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Stay or Go Portable 6 Quart Slow Cooker with Lid Lock for Easy Transport, Dishwasher-Safe Crock, Stainless Steel (33461)
features: Single clip seals lid onto base to reduce messy spills
Bring 6 quarts of hot food to potlucks or parties anytime
Hinged lid stays up then easily detaches for dishwasher cleanup
Folding handles snap up for carrying and fold down for storage
High, low and keep warm settings
description: From soup day Saturdays to an occasional party pot roast, the Hamilton Beach stay or go 6 quart lid latch strap slow cooker has you covered. Fabulous for home use but flexible enough to take on the Road, This slow cooker is designed to meet your needs.
